notes: Web services expose the broadest attack surface. Research management interfaces, exposed VCS metadata, CMS fingerprints, and default credentials for any identified product before generic fuzzing.

checks.title: Administrative / management interface exposed
checks.when: an admin, manager, or console path responds (e.g. /admin, /manager/html, /console, /wp-admin)
checks.validation: Request the admin path once and read the auth behavior; do not attempt logins without approval.

checks.title: Exposed .git directory
checks.validation: Fetch /.git/HEAD; if present, dumping source is possible with git-dumper (approval + scope required).

checks.title: Sensitive functionality without authentication
checks.when: a sensitive endpoint returns 200 with no auth challenge
checks.validation: Observe response codes/headers for an auth challenge; classify as absent/anonymous/authenticated — do not assume.

checks.title: Default credentials on identified web product
checks.when: a product with documented default credentials is fingerprinted
checks.validation: Try the single vendor-documented default ONCE with approval and within scope. No brute-force, no wordlists.
